items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: It's a trumpet player by the name of Lucky.

ctx.x: We called him Frog. He's a cripple. On trombone. He was a sweet... He's still a sweet guy. Yeah, he's still playing nice. He's still a sweet guy. Well, we called him Frog. And, uh... It's a trumpet player by the name of Lucky.
You wouldn't even know him, I don't think. Just not.
